jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The input image is the approved EDIT TARGET character, not loose inspiration. Create a production SPRITE ANIMATION SHEET of this EXACT character, with exactly FOUR frames arranged in a perfectly aligned 2 by 2 grid. TRANSPARENT background, no letters, no labels, no borders or grid lines, no floor or shadow. Equal-sized quadrants, a complete character centered in each quadrant with comfortable empty margin. Maintain IDENTICAL character identity, colors, clothing, face, hair, head size, body proportions, coarse pixel density, scale and viewing angle across all 4 frames. Head and torso size MUST NOT change between cells. Feet share the same ground baseline within each cell; body horizontal center identical. Preserve the reference's compact ADULT (25+) fantasy RPG pixel style, large head, short limbs, dark outlines, no antialiasing, no painterly detail. Designed to be extracted into 48x64 pixel cells, body fits within 44x60 logical pixels. All four frames fully contained in their quadrant without crossing boundaries. Each frame is one complete same-sized sprite. No multiple characters per quadrant. Pose variations must be clear and usable at this tiny scale. No new ornaments or costume changes. The target is explicitly an adult character despite stylized proportions. Facing gently LEFT in every frame. Exactly these four poses in row-major order: TOP LEFT = IDLE standing with both feet down and relaxed arms, reproduce reference pose and face. TOP RIGHT = WALK 1, near leg stepping clearly forward toward left and far leg back, near arm swings backward, small hair/accessory sway. BOTTOM LEFT = WALK 2, REVERSE the leg and arm positions from walk 1, far leg now forward and near leg back, opposite hair/accessory sway. Walking frames must have visibly DIFFERENT opposing foot and arm positions, side-on three-quarter stride, not identical idle copies. BOTTOM RIGHT = PURCHASE COMPLETE, feet back together in stationary stance, face noticeably happy and relieved, one hand extended OPEN toward left at waist height ready to receive a separate potion sprite, other hand near torso in pleased gesture. Do not paint any bottle or potion into the frame: game overlays its own bottle in the hand. Keep head scale and location stable. Character: approved female traveler, brown loose unbraided hair, cream shirt, green hood DOWN, brown SHORTS, huge backpack and bedroll, brown boots. The backpack stays on her back in EVERY frame, it gently bobs during walk. Preserve every defining design element.
